description: One review lists four numbered tweaks of four different types.

recipe.title: Best Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Gather your ingredients, making sure your butter is softened, and your eggs are room temperature.
Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Beat butter, white sugar, and brown sugar with an electric mixer in a large bowl until smooth.
Beat in eggs, one at a time, then stir in vanilla.
Dissolve baking soda in hot water. Add to batter along with salt.
Stir in flour, chocolate chips, and walnuts.
Drop spoonfuls of dough 2 inches apart onto ungreased baking sheets.
Bake in the preheated oven until edges are nicely browned, about 10 minutes.
Cool on the baking sheets briefly before removing to a wire rack to cool completely.
Store in an airtight container or serve immediately and enjoy!

reviews.text: These are awesome cookies. I followed the advice of others by making the following tweaks: (1) I used a half cup of sugar and one-and-a-half cups of brown sugar; (2) I omitted the water; (3) I added a teaspoon of cream of tartar to the batter; (4) I refrigerated the batter for at least an hour before scooping and baking. The cookies retained their shape and didn't spread when baked. I think the cream of tartar made a difference, and the cookies did not come out too cakey either! This recipe is going in my "favorites" cookbook.

policy: Apply a tweak only if the reviewer tried it and reported a positive outcome. Reviews are applied in order of rating (high first), then file order; when two reviews change the same recipe line, the earlier one wins and the later tweak is recorded as a conflict. Every tweak not applied is reported with a reason.
